decisions.reason: As a newly launched plugin tightly linked to the firm's core web-GIS offering and already showing active iteration through several releases, it remains a low-cost option whose market potential is still unfolding.
This hierarchical search plugin is close to the established offer, likely inexpensive to maintain, and after only its launch year there is too little evidence to justify abandoning the option.

The mobile map control component fits the firm's strategic direction toward user-focused enterprise geospatial solutions, and the launch communication points to a clear usability benefit that warrants keeping it on the market.

A GIS solution platform is strategically adjacent to the firm's integration capabilities, and despite limited public evidence, the uncertainty is still too high in 2019 to abandon such a potentially valuable option.

Mobile field data capture software is close to customer workflows in enterprise and public-sector GIS, so management would keep this recently launched product while demand and fit are still being tested.

As a search extension for web map applications that complements the existing portfolio and likely has modest continuation costs, it is sensible to keep the option open after only one year on the market.
